en: Alex big congratulations that was not easy
with the rain delay you had the momentum
but you had to fight hard in the end
and dig deep how would you able
to pull another tie breakout
in a challenging match?
Yeah look obviously you never really want
to go into rain delay being 5 -1 up I think
it's it was a tough day there was five
or six rain delays I can't remember a match
that I've had where there's
been so many starts and stops
but I'm happy with the way I found
a way I mean again it got it got tough
at the end probably a little bit harder than it
should have been but I dug deep I got
through and I'm excited
to be in the next round.
I like what you said
after a previous match too those challenges
can be so rewarding what positive outlook
can you take from getting through this one
as well?
Yeah exactly that I mean it
was a very tough match from from start
to finish I think you know I played
a very very good match until that kind
of last rain delay right and then then
at the end I had to dig deep I had to kind
of reset just take it a point by at a time
and I managed to dig a big kind
of tiebreak again like I
did in that first round match
so look I'm taking positives
and I'm taking a lot of confidence out
of these types of tough wins and you
know hopefully every day I feel better
and I play better.
Fantastic way to get through good job.
Thank you.
